request.query: The determinant of successive Hasse derivatives of a finite family of polynomials over a characteristic zero field equals zero if and only if the family is not linearly independent

items.name: Algebra.discr_zero_of_not_linearIndependent
items.type:
∀ (A : Type u) {B : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra A B] [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [IsDomain A] {b : ι → B}, ¬LinearIndependent A b → Algebra.discr A b = 0

items.name: Matrix.gram_apply
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_4} [inst : Inner 𝕜 E] (v : n → E) (i j : n),
  Matrix.gram 𝕜 v i j = inner 𝕜 (v i) (v j)

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_cols
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A.transpose i) → A.det = 0

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_rows
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A i) → A.det = 0

items.name: Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] ℕ →₀ Polynomial R

items.name: Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, A.det ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent R A.col

items.name: Matrix.det_vandermonde_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} [IsDomain R] {v : Fin n → R},
  (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = 0 ↔ ∃ i j, v i = v j ∧ i ≠ j

items.name: Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} [IsDomain R] {v : Fin n → R},
  (Matrix.vandermonde v).det ≠ 0 ↔ Function.Injective v
